items.title: OpenAI previews ‘Ultrafast’ GPT-5.6 Sol running up to 14 times faster
items.title_zh: OpenAI 预览“Ultrafast”版 GPT-5.6 Sol，速度最高提升 14 倍
items.summary: OpenAI is previewing a new service tier called Ultrafast that can run its GPT-5.6 Sol model up to 14 times faster than standard processing.

items.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6, claiming GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5-level intelligence
items.title_zh: SpaceXAI 发布 Grok 4.6，自称达到 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude Fable 5 级智能
items.summary: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.6, claiming its intelligence is comparable to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, following its recent Cursor acquisition and Grok Bot agent release.

items.title: Claude's new Scarlet Letter watermark is invisible—for now
items.title_zh: Claude 新的“红字”水印目前不可见——暂时如此
items.summary: Anthropic's new watermark, dubbed the Scarlet Letter, flags anything Claude processed — including human writing it only edited — and is currently invisible, according to Ars Technica.

items.title: Anthropic could be worth $2 trillion when it goes public
items.title_zh: Anthropic 上市时估值或达 2 万亿美元
items.summary: Ars Technica reports rapid revenue growth fuels hope that Claude maker Anthropic's IPO will be the biggest listing in history, with a potential valuation of $2 trillion.

items.title: Former ByteDance robotics head reportedly joins Xiaomi
items.title_zh: 前字节跳动机器人团队负责人据报加入小米
items.summary: Former ByteDance robotics team head Kong Tao has reportedly joined Xiaomi, where he now leads a team developing foundation models for robots, bringing several former ByteDance colleagues with him. Xiaomi's robotics division is said to have about 200 employees.

items.title: Unitree opens A-share IPO subscription
items.title_zh: 宇树科技开启 A 股 IPO 申购
items.summary: Unitree opened online subscription for its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's STAR Market on Aug. 10, described by Chinese media as the country's first IPO by a humanoid robot maker, attracting attention for its relatively small public float.

items.title: Chinese Makers Accounted for More Than 97% of Global Humanoid Robot Shipments in H1 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 上半年中国厂商占全球人形机器人出货量 97% 以上
items.summary: Chinese manufacturers accounted for more than 97% of global humanoid robot shipments in H1 2026, with total shipments of about 19,100 units, up from roughly 5,100 units a year earlier. AgiBot shipped about 8,400 units (44% of the total) and Unitree about 5,900 units.

items.title: Zhang Yiming Returns to ByteDance Headquarters and Tells the Seed Team to Stop Distilling
items.title_zh: 张一鸣回归字节总部，要求 Seed 团队停止蒸馏
items.summary: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming quietly returned to the Seed AI research team two weeks ago and laid down a no-distillation mandate, according to Pandaily. A mid-year all-hands followed with a major B-side structure change putting Doubao, Feishu and Volcano Engine under one product roof.

items.title: Former Qwen Tech Chief Lin Junyang Launches Pragmatik Labs with a Two-Billion-Dollar Valuation — and Pivots from Foundation Models to Agents
items.title_zh: 前通义技术负责人林军阳创立 Pragmatik Labs，估值 20 亿美元并转向智能体
items.summary: Former Alibaba Qwen technical lead Lin Junyang has founded Pragmatik Labs in Shanghai with a $2 billion angel-round valuation, co-led by Gaorong and HongShan with $100 million each plus $20 million from Tencent, positioning around digital and physical agents.

items.title: WeChat AI Team Details WeLM Models Scaling to 617B Parameters
items.title_zh: 微信 AI 团队披露 WeLM 模型扩展至 617B 参数
items.summary: Tencent's WeChat AI team detailed a scaling approach called Hidden Decoding for its WeLM family, training WeLM-HD4-80B and WeLM-HD4-617B models that expand each token into multiple internal computation streams without enlarging the main Transformer backbone; the 80B model activates 3 billion parameters.

items.summary: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.6, claiming its intelligence is comparable to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, following its recent Cursor acquisition and Grok Bot agent release.

items.summary: Ars Technica reports rapid revenue growth fuels hope that Claude maker Anthropic's IPO will be the biggest listing in history, with a potential valuation of $2 trillion.

items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash 发布
items.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.7 Flash, drawing 174 points and 118 comments on Hacker News; it launches three weeks after the previous model, live in Google's Spark.

items.title: Tesla unveils first Cybercab with Starlink antenna integrated
items.title_zh: 特斯拉展示首款集成 Starlink 天线的 Cybercab
items.summary: Tesla's robotaxi account posted photos of what it calls the first Cybercab with a Starlink antenna built into the vehicle — a gold Cybercab at Gigafactory Texas with a low-profile satellite antenna integrated into the roof.

items.title: Waymo has nearly 1,000 robotaxis waiting at its Arizona factory
items.title_zh: Waymo 亚利桑那工厂停放着近千辆 Robotaxi 待部署
items.summary: Waymo has 684 of its new Ojai robotaxis finished and ready to deploy at its Mesa, Arizona factory, out of 953 Ojai vehicles on the lot in total (72% converted), according to the latest aerial count.

items.title: Honor finally launches Robot Phone starting at around $1,500
items.title_zh: 荣耀 Robot Phone 正式发布，起售价约 1500 美元
items.summary: Honor's gimbal-touting AI-first Robot Phone has made its debut starting at around $1,500, though it will not be sold in most of the world at launch.

items.title: Apple reveals how Siri AI features work in China – raising privacy questions
items.title_zh: 苹果披露 Siri AI 功能在华运行方式，引发隐私质疑
items.summary: Apple revealed its new Siri AI features in China will be powered by Alibaba's Qwen models, because Chinese government rules require a local AI partner instead of Google's Gemini used in most countries, raising privacy questions.

items.title: Pixel 11 Pro launches with the best of Google’s Gemini Intelligence starting at $1,099 [Hands-on]
items.title_zh: Pixel 11 Pro 发布，搭载 Gemini Intelligence，起售价 1099 美元
items.summary: Google's Pixel 11 Pro runs on its newest Android with Gemini Intelligence features, starting at $1,099 — a higher entry price than usual due to one big change to storage.

items.title: Spaghettifying DRAM
items.title_zh: “意面化 DRAM”：内存攻击新研究
items.summary: A Hacker News item (303 points, 87 comments) highlighting a GitHub project exploring DRAM attacks dubbed "spaghettifying DRAM" — no further description is published.

items.title: Former ByteDance robotics head reportedly joins Xiaomi
items.title_zh: 前字节跳动机器人团队负责人据报加入小米

items.title: Unitree Robotics Has Built Industrial Colleges in Ten Manufacturing Hubs Ahead of Its IPO
items.title_zh: 宇树科技 IPO 前已在十个制造枢纽共建产业学院
items.summary: Ahead of its IPO, Unitree has signed industrial-college partnerships with more than ten universities across ten manufacturing-heavy cities including Qingdao, Hefei, Suzhou, Wuhan and Guangzhou, with research and education accounting for a significant share of demand.

items.title_zh: 微信 AI 团队披露 WeLM 模型扩展至 617B 参数

items.title: China GPU maker Moore Threads plans Hong Kong listing after H1 revenue jumps 147%
items.title_zh: 中国 GPU 厂商摩尔线程 H1 营收增长 147% 后计划赴港上市
items.summary: Moore Threads' board approved a plan to issue H shares and seek a listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's Main Board; the plan was approved Aug. 7 and disclosed Aug. 10, with timetable and offering size not finalized. First-half revenue reportedly jumped 147%.

items.title: XPeng Opens Pre-Sale of G9L Flagship SUV at 25.98 Million Yuan — and Previews Second-Gen VLA 6.3.0
items.title_zh: 小鹏 G9L 旗舰 SUV 开启预售（25.98 万元起），并预告第二代 VLA 6.3.0
items.summary: XPeng unveiled the G9L flagship five-seat SUV in Guangzhou on Aug. 11 with a 259,800 yuan pre-sale entry price across four trims, and previewed its second-generation VLA model 6.3.0 which triples end-side model parameter count and adds L4-grade Robotaxi features.

items.title: Honor Launches Robot Phone with Gimbal Camera and AI Agent Features
items.title_zh: 荣耀发布搭载云台相机与 AI 智能体的 Robot Phone
items.summary: Honor launched its Robot Phone with a four-degree-of-freedom titanium gimbal and system-level AI agent architecture: about 9.59mm thick, 248g, 7,060mAh battery, 6.31-inch display; the 12GB+512GB version is priced at 9,999 yuan.

items.title: Zhipu’s API User Base Nears 7 Million as It Adds 50,000-Plus Chinese AI Chips
items.title_zh: 智谱 API 用户接近 700 万，并新增 5 万+ 国产 AI 芯片
items.summary: Zhipu's API user base is nearing 7 million as the company adds more than 50,000 Chinese AI chips to its infrastructure, according to TechNode.

items.title: ByteDance Reportedly Forms New AI Data and Safety Department
items.title_zh: 字节跳动据报新设 AI 数据与安全部门
items.summary: ByteDance has reportedly formed a new top-level department focused on AI data and safety, placed alongside Seed, Flow and Douyin in its organizational structure, led by former TikTok executive Wang Yinglei; it reportedly grew out of a global data team.

items.title: DeepSeek Posts Civil Engineering Jobs as Chinese Tech Giants Re-Define Their Asset Boundary Around Compute Infrastructure
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布土建工程岗位，中国科技巨头围绕算力基础设施重划资产边界
items.summary: DeepSeek posted an open call for electrical, HVAC, environmental and civil engineering talent to design and operate AI compute infrastructure in Hangzhou, Beijing and Ulanqab, following ByteDance's parallel push into non-residential real estate leasing in Zhongwei.

items.title: Doubao Introduces a 12% Service Fee for Hotel Bookings Made Through Its Channel
items.title_zh: 豆包对通过其渠道的酒店预订收取 12% 服务费
items.summary: ByteDance's Doubao began applying a fee structure to hotel bookings through its channel on Douyin's local-services platform: a combined charge of about 12%, including an 11.4% software service fee and a 0.6% payment fee, effective Aug. 10.

items.title: 中国机器人公司上市潮：宇树之后，如何定价？
items.title_zh: 中国机器人公司上市潮：宇树之后，如何定价？
items.summary: 文章讨论宇树科技上市之后中国机器人公司掀起的新一轮上市潮，并分析资本市场应如何为这些公司定价。

items.title: Alibaba Launches CosyVoice Studio, Its First Full-Stack Voice AI Platform, and Bets Speech Is the Next Productivity Entry Point
items.title_zh: 阿里发布首个全栈语音 AI 平台 CosyVoice Studio
items.summary: CosyVoice Studio bundles Alibaba's Qwen-Audio speech family — including the Artificial Analysis top-ranked Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime — into one platform with three product modules, positioning speech as the next agent entry point alongside text and vision.

items.title: cactus-compute/needle
items.title_zh: cactus-compute/needle：14MB 端侧基础模型
items.summary: needle is a 14MB foundation model for tiny devices — phones, wearables, smart home and robots — trending on GitHub with a focus match for robotics and AI/ML.

items.title: 0xnyn/airship
items.title_zh: 0xnyn/airship：面向 Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode 的类 Figma 可视化编辑器
items.summary: airship is a Figma-like visual editor built for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, trending on GitHub.

items.title: wzchav/tokentab
items.title_zh: wzchav/tokentab：CLI 记账工具，统计 AI 编码会话成本
items.summary: tokentab is a CLI that reads Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI session logs and computes their cost by model, project and day.

items.title: unslothai/unsloth
items.title_zh: unslothai/unsloth：本地训练/运行 LLM 与扩散模型的 UI
items.summary: unsloth's local UI runs and trains LLMs and diffusion models including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4 and FLUX, trending on GitHub.

items.title: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard
items.title_zh: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard：跨模型/服务商的 LLM 路由层
items.summary: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility, enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking and cost/performance optimization.

items.title: infiniflow/ragflow
items.title_zh: infiniflow/ragflow：开源 RAG 引擎
items.summary: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation engine that fuses RAG with agent capabilities to create a context layer for LLMs.

items.title: macro-inc/macro
items.title_zh: macro-inc/macro：带共享 AI 记忆的统一协作工作区
items.summary: Macro is a unified workspace for teams — email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory, built in Rust.

items.title: Scrappy-Doo/GLM-5.2
items.title_zh: Scrappy-Doo/GLM-5.2：GLM 架构对话模型权重
items.summary: A GLM-5.2 model using the glm_moe_dsa architecture uploaded for conversational text generation, with 2,183 downloads.

items.title: pauleb/Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_M-GGUF
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-27B 的 Q4_K_M GGUF 量化版本
items.summary: A Q4_K_M GGUF quantization of Qwen3.6-27B, an image-text-to-text model, uploaded for local inference via llama.cpp.

items.title: artindnr/Strawberry
items.title_zh: artindnr/Strawberry：GPT-OSS 架构 MoE 模型权重
items.summary: Strawberry is a mixture-of-experts text-generation model using the gpt_oss architecture with mxfp4 quantization, at 346 downloads and 5 likes.

items.title: Sachin21112004/distilbart-news-summarizer
items.title_zh: distilbart-news-summarizer：新闻摘要模型
items.summary: A DistilBART news summarization model with 3,065 downloads and 17 likes, exported in multiple formats including PyTorch, JAX and Rust.

items.title: asdl-unist/smolvla_0811_1
items.title_zh: asdl-unist/smolvla_0811_1：SmolVLA 机器人策略权重
items.summary: A SmolVLA robotics policy checkpoint from ASDL-UNIST, tagged for LeRobot and trained on the new_aicp_carrot dataset.

items.title: SLAC: Access-Driven CPU-to-GPU Side-channel Attacks via System-Level Cache on Apple Silicon
items.title_zh: SLAC：基于系统级缓存的 CPU 到 GPU 访问驱动侧信道攻击（Apple Silicon）
items.summary: This paper demonstrates access-driven CPU-to-GPU side-channel attacks on Apple Silicon via the shared system-level cache (SLC), exposing a cross-domain attack surface in heterogeneous SoCs where CPU and GPU share the last-level cache.

items.title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 汇合式绕行劫持：技能型 LLM 智能体的任务保留资源放大攻击
items.summary: The paper describes Convergent Detour Hijacking, a security threat in skill-based LLM agents where untrusted skill publishers can exploit the progressive-disclosure design (natural-language selection + instruction bodies) to amplify resource use while preserving the task.

items.title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
items.title_zh: 基于 SMPC 演示与稀疏离线-在线强化学习的移动操作学习
items.summary: The paper proposes learning locomotion-manipulation from SMPC demonstrations with sparse offline-to-online RL, addressing the bottleneck of scaling standard RL to complex robot tasks.

items.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
items.title_zh: G0.5：单一自回归流统一机器人推理与动作
items.summary: G0.5 proposes a single autoregressive stream for robot reasoning and action, replacing the prevailing VLA recipe that couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert.

items.title: NetlistBench: Evaluating LLM Reliability in SPICE Netlist Recognition and Manipulation
items.title_zh: NetlistBench：评估 LLM 在 SPICE 网表识别与操作中的可靠性
items.summary: NetlistBench evaluates how reliably LLMs handle simulator-facing SPICE netlist recognition and manipulation in circuit design workflows, an area that remains poorly understood.

items.title: A Full-Stack Characterization of High-Bandwidth Flash for KV-Centric LLM Serving
items.title_zh: 面向 KV 为主的 LLM 服务的高带宽闪存全栈特性分析
items.summary: The paper provides a full-stack characterization of High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF), which stacks NAND behind a wide package-local interface giving flash-scale capacity with better read latency and bandwidth than SSD, for KV-centric LLM serving.
